name: agentguards-claude
description: LLM security guardrails for Claude Code — jailbreak detection, prompt-injection and web-content scanning, data-exfiltration blocking, and destructive-command authorization. Bundles the AgentGuards MCP server plus enforcing hooks.

agentguards_api_key.title: AgentGuards API key
agentguards_api_key.description: Your ag_ token from agentguards.co/dashboard/keys. Only needed here in surfaces with no shell profile (e.g. Claude Desktop's Chat tab) — CLI users who already export AGENTGUARDS_API_KEY can leave this blank.

agentguards_url.title: AgentGuards URL
agentguards_url.description: Only change this for a self-hosted instance. Defaults to the hosted service.
